summary: Tested Comunicación Masiva chooser (A Integradores / A Bancos/Entes) backend+UI using fixtures only (bnk_TEST_*, int_TEST_*, tpl_TEST_* with @example.com). Backend 13/13 pass (1 skip: non-admin jrojas credentials invalid). Integrator flow regression OK after _mass_dispatch refactor (same response shape, 400 empty ids, 400 no email, 404 bad template). Bank endpoints: GET recipients structure OK (incl. legacy contact_* fallback); POST sends only selected keys, dedups case-insensitively, ignores unknown keys, 400 empty/invalid JSON/no valid email, 404 template, 422 missing repo doc, local attachments counted, bitacora action=bank_mass_communication with recipients + bank_ids. UI: chooser -> integrators dialog unchanged; chooser -> banks dialog grouped grid, master select all (95/95), granular deselect keeps others, bank checkbox indeterminate & toggles block, master indeterminate, template preview renders HTML, send to fixture bank returned exactly the 2 checked recipients and toast + close. All fixtures, bitacora and email_logs test entries removed.

minor.issue: contact_keys are index-based (bank_id::idx). If a bank's contacts are edited/reordered between opening the dialog and sending, a different person may receive the mail. Consider stable contact_id keys (contacts already have contact_id).

Integrator email field in real data often contains multiple addresses with display names (e.g. "Johan ... <jloza...>, ... <jchirivi@109apps.com>"); backend passes the whole string as a single BCC entry (only checks '@'). Could fail SMTP/Resend for those recipients. Not introduced by this change.

ui_bugs.issue: Selections hidden by the search filter remain selected and are sent. Repro: Seleccionar Todos (95) -> search fixture bank -> counter/send button still say 95; master checkbox then only toggles visible rows (95->91). Risk of unintended sends to real bank contacts. Suggest: clear selection on search change, or show warning / 'X ocultos seleccionados', or restrict send to visible.

issues: Template HTML rendered without prose/typography styles: <h2> shows as plain body text due to Tailwind preflight (add 'prose' or basic heading styles) - minor

action_items: Handle hidden-by-search selections in BankMassCommunicationDialog (clear on search or show/limit) to avoid accidental sends to real bank contacts
Optional: use contact_id instead of positional index for contact_keys
Note: preview env has no INTEGRADORES templates and empty INTEGRADORES repository; test used a fixture template
critical_code_review_comments: Old test tests/test_iter274_mass_communication.py teardown deletes bitacora/email_logs by action + recipients_count in [1,2] — broad filter that can delete real entries; should be scoped by template/ids
_mass_dispatch saves uploaded files before validating internal docs; on 422 the saved local files are orphaned (pre-existing behavior)
Frontend dialog fetch errors are silently swallowed (catch -> []), user sees 'Sin contactos' instead of an error toast
